svg.title: Exact-layout-first SABRE routing
svg.desc: Routing first searches for an exact SWAP-free embedding; otherwise it keeps the best of several SABRE layout trials, then repeatedly emits the executable front layer and inserts the best-scoring SWAP or bridge until the circuit is exhausted. Finally the routed circuit moves to the best-calibrated qubits that keep it executable.
svg.text: D: shortest-path distance · E: next 2Q gates · W: extended-set weight · decay: busy qubits
Re-layout: only with per-qubit calibration and no pinned layout; moves only if strictly cheaper
